$about: howtoai-dev settings. Each leaf has a type, a default, and a description. User defaults live in ~/.claude/howtoai/dev-settings.json; project values in <workspace>/.howtoai/dev/settings.json win over them. Never store secrets here: name accounts and profiles, not their credentials.

plan_folder.description: Folder at the workspace root that holds one subfolder per change and INDEX.md.

kind.description: Where work items go: Markdown files in the change folder, Jira through the Atlassian MCP, or GitHub Issues.

jira_project.description: Jira project key, when kind is jira.

jira_issue_type.description: Jira issue type for a work item.

allow.description: Targets tests may use. Each item: {"name", "kind": local|dev|test|remote-test, "match": {"host"|"database"|"profile"|"env": value}}.

deny.description: Production markers the safety hook denies: host names, connection-string fragments, cloud profiles, or account names.

hook_rules.description: Enforceable process rules the hooks read. Each item: {"id", "match": regex on the command or path, "action": warn|block, "reason"}.

confidence_threshold.description: Findings scored below this go to the review doc's appendix.

max_rounds.description: Goldfish loop cap; at the cap the user decides.

clean_rounds_to_stop.description: Consecutive rounds without Blocker or Major findings that end the loop.

entry_points.description: Existing deploy commands, scripts, or workflow names, in the order they run, each {"name", "command" or "workflow", "target"}.

technologies.description: Languages and tools the project uses, for example ["csharp", "dotnet", "docker", "terraform"]; dev-workbook keeps one workbook for each.
